answer: By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The ripple holds work receipts rather than names, so the violet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
